description: Phase 4a gate — WAL read-side open protocol. Error paths + empty-WAL-unlink + no-WAL regression. Algorithm per spec/wal.spec.md § 'Phase 4a open protocol'. No new VDBE opcodes; max_invariant=42 unchanged. Frame-overlay behaviour (real committed frames with Fibonacci checksums and roundtrip with mainline) is tested out-of-band via tests/roundtrip_wal_readside.py (deferred). All prior phase fixtures must stay green.

schema.case: inherits phase3d.json schema plus two new fields:
schema.preload_wal_hex: string — optional, disk-only. Hex bytes (no prefix, no separators) written to <path>-wal BEFORE the first open. Harness writes EXACTLY these bytes (no padding). The open protocol MUST process the WAL per spec § 'Phase 4a open protocol' — either unlinking it on success (after checkpoint) or raising STORAGE_WAL_* on failure.
schema.wal_absent_after_open: bool — optional. If true, the test additionally asserts that <path>-wal does NOT exist on the filesystem at the point of this expect-block. Pins the unlink-after-checkpoint contract.

cases.name: disk-no-wal-sidecar-regression
cases.description: Phase 3d regression — DB opens and mutates normally when no WAL sidecar is present.

cases.name: disk-empty-wal-sidecar-is-absorbed-and-unlinked
cases.description: WAL sidecar with a valid header and ZERO frames. Open succeeds; <path>-wal is unlinked post-open (zero-frame checkpoint = no DB bytes change, but WAL absorption still runs).

cases.name: disk-wal-corrupt-magic-raises
cases.description: WAL header magic is 0xdeadbeef, not 0x377f0682. Open raises STORAGE_WAL_CORRUPT_HEADER.

cases.name: disk-wal-wrong-page-size-raises
cases.description: WAL header page_size is 0x00000200 (=512) but main DB uses 4096. Open raises STORAGE_WAL_CORRUPT_HEADER.

cases.name: disk-wal-wrong-format-version-raises
cases.description: WAL header format version is 0x00000001, not 3007000. Open raises STORAGE_WAL_CORRUPT_HEADER.

cases.name: disk-wal-truncated-header-raises
cases.description: WAL file exists but is shorter than 32 bytes (16 bytes). Open raises STORAGE_WAL_CORRUPT_HEADER (insufficient header bytes).
